description: 전문가 의뢰 후보·외형 검증, 영입 초기 상태 재계산, 귀족 부인 생성 문법 수정

add_locations.name: jo9_expert_order
add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START EXPERT_ORDER_FINAL_20261127_RULES
if $args[0] = 'enabled':
 result = 1
 if search['age'] = 3 and fresh_mode = 1: result = 0
 if search['age'] = 1 and no_milf = 1: result = 0
 exit
end

if $args[0] = 'matches':
 result = dyneval($replace({
  result = 0
  if jo9candidate_state ! CONST_INT['slave_exist']: exit
  local jo9appearance = jo9candidate['age']
  if jo9appearance = CONST_INT['fresh_age'] and (fresh_mode = 1 or search['age'] = 5): exit
  if jo9appearance = CONST_INT['mature_age'] and (no_milf = 1 or search['age'] = 4): exit
  if search['age'] = 1 and jo9appearance ! CONST_INT['mature_age']: exit
  if search['age'] = 2 and jo9appearance ! CONST_INT['young_age']: exit
  if search['age'] = 3 and jo9appearance ! CONST_INT['fresh_age']: exit
  if jo9candidate['jo9_learning_trait'] = -1 and jo9candidate['intellect'] ! 0: exit
  if jo9candidate['jo9_learning_trait'] = 1 and jo9candidate['intellect'] ! 5: exit
  if jo9candidate['fat'] > 3 and jo9candidate['stamina'] > 4: exit
  if jo9candidate['beauty'] < search['beauty'] or jo9candidate['stamina'] < search['stamina']: exit
  if jo9candidate['sensitivity'] < search['sensitivity'] or jo9candidate['intellect'] < search['intellect']: exit
  if jo9candidate['temper'] < search['temper'] or jo9candidate['ego'] < search['ego']: exit
  result = 1
 }, 'jo9candidate', $args[1]))
 exit
end

if $args[0] = 'initialize':
 dynamic $replace({
  if jo9candidate['ego'] >= 4 or jo9candidate['pride'] >= 4 or jo9candidate['defiant'] = 1: jo9candidate['jo9_slave_nature'] = 0
  if $seed_psy_basic[jo9candidate_type] = '' and ($jo9candidate_psy_basic = 'depresive' or $jo9candidate_psy_basic = 'lachrymose'):
   $jo9candidate_psy_basic = iif(jo9candidate['sensitivity'] >= 4, 'lachrymose', 'depresive')
  end
  jo9candidate['calories'] = jo9candidate['stamina']
  jo9candidate['energy'] = iif(jo9candidate['stamina'] > 0, min(5, jo9candidate['stamina'] + iif(difficulty_setting = 2, 0, 1)), 0)
 }, 'jo9candidate', $args[1])
 gs 'jo9_expert_order','initial_mood',$args[1]
 exit
end

if $args[0] = 'initial_mood':
 dynamic $replace({
  jo9candidate['neg_slave'] = 1 + jo9candidate['pride'] + jo9candidate['temper'] + jo9candidate['ego'] + jo9candidate['intellect'] - jo9candidate['rational'] - jo9candidate['custom']
 }, 'jo9candidate', $args[1])
 exit
end

if $args[0] = 'revalidate':
 result = 0
 if search['active'] < 2: exit
 if func('jo9_expert_order','matches','selected') = 1:
  result = 1
 else
  search['active'] = 1
  dynamic $clear_slave_instance, 'selected'
 end
 exit
end

if $args[0] = 'submit':
 if search['active'] = 0 and search['cost'] > 0:
  if func('jo9_expert_order','enabled') = 1:
   search['active'] = 1
   sparks -= search['cost'] * 70
  else
   msg '현재 출현 설정에서는 그 외형을 의뢰할 수 없다.'
  end
 end
end
! JO9 MOD END EXPERT_ORDER_FINAL_20261127_RULES
